integrity: Proof uses exact block equations; a standalone independent computational enumeration of finite cases corroborates it, but finite checks are not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled ordered pairs of idempotent matrices with idempotent product and prescribed three ranks; does not count simultaneous-similarity orbits or triple products. Earlier related literature (Laffey 1983) only abstract-accessible, so historical priority is not independently certified. Independent mathematical review not performed.
title: Complete three-rank census of idempotent matrix pairs with idempotent product
